method: STRIDE per trust boundary; risk = likelihood (1-5) x impact (1-5)

included: Order, Payment, Cart and User business logic
Payment gateway abstraction and recovery worker
excluded: Cloud/network controls not present in this repository
Security guarantees of a future real payment gateway

assets.name: Payment state, amount and idempotency records
JWT signing key and database connection secret

trust_boundaries.name: Internet client to ASP.NET Core API

threats.threat: Forge or omit identity and act as another customer
threats.vulnerability: Missing authentication or failure to bind a route resource to the authenticated subject
threats.attack: Call protected Order, Cart or Payment routes without a valid subject or with another user's identifier

threats.threat: Change client-supplied price, total or payment amount
threats.vulnerability: Trusting request monetary values without server-side recomputation and cross-aggregate checks
threats.attack: Submit a cheap UnitPrice/TotalAmount or pay an amount different from the stored order total

threats.threat: Deny having initiated a payment, retry or cancellation
threats.vulnerability: Application logs are not a durable, append-only audit trail and do not define correlation/retention guarantees
threats.attack: Dispute a state-changing request after logs rotate or lack sufficient actor and correlation context
threats.recommendation: Persist an append-only audit event containing actor, action, resource, correlation id, timestamp and outcome; protect integrity and define retention.

threats.threat: Read another customer's order, cart or payment
threats.vulnerability: Predictable identifiers become an IDOR when ownership is not checked on every read path
threats.attack: Enumerate resource identifiers and request another customer's aggregate

threats.threat: Exhaust API, database or recovery capacity
threats.vulnerability: Repository has no explicit rate limit and no documented maximum order-item collection size
threats.attack: Flood authentication/business endpoints or submit repeatedly large order payloads
threats.recommendation: Add request/body and item-count limits, per-identity/IP rate limiting, gateway timeout and load tests.

threats.threat: Invoke administrator-only listing or refund operations
threats.vulnerability: Missing role enforcement or acceptance of an untrusted/incorrectly signed role claim
threats.attack: Call Admin endpoints with a customer token or a forged Admin claim
controls: minimum JWT key length at startup

threats.threat: Exploit concurrent payment/cancel or invalid transitions to corrupt workflow state
threats.vulnerability: Unserialized transitions can revive terminal orders, double-charge, or diverge inventory and payment state
threats.attack: Race payment against cancellation or replay the same payment operation

threats.threat: Supply a forged or replayed successful gateway result
threats.vulnerability: Current FakePaymentGateway cannot establish authenticity guarantees of a production callback/response
threats.attack: Forge SUCCESS or replay a transaction code so an unpaid order appears paid
threats.recommendation: For the real adapter, validate provider signature, timestamp/nonce, merchant and amount before accepting SUCCESS.

threats.threat: Expose JWT key or database credentials through source, logs or weak host permissions
threats.vulnerability: Secrets copied into source-controlled configuration or emitted in diagnostic output
threats.attack: Read leaked configuration and forge tokens or connect directly to the database
threats.recommendation: Use a deployment secret manager, rotate secrets and verify repository/history with secret scanning.
